[[File:Medium port reward bag detail.png|130px|left]]
'''Medium port reward bags''' are possible rewards from completing a [[courier tasks|courier task]]. They may contain either loot from a shared drop table, or loot that is unique to the task's destination [[Mooring point|port]]. The size of [[port reward bag]] given from a task is determined by the [[Sailing]] experience awarded for that task; medium bags are given from Courier Tasks giving 1,000–2,499 XP.
Several types of medium reward bag are not obtainable, as some ports have no tasks which give XP corresponding to a medium bag.
